goal: Name the requested code and the received code in the ColdLion /prepackDetail loader's identity-collision refusals, so a live refusal is diagnosable from the run log alone. Fail-closed behaviour unchanged.
dispatcher: delegated source-data session continuing issue #3179 production phase
prohibited_actions: Never weaken the identity guard: a row answering another request still aborts the run before anything lands; only the message changes.
Never author a migration or change any database shape.
Never put row values other than the requested and received codes into any message, log, or committed file.
Never close issue #3179; the originating session owns closure.
assumptions: The identity collision is real vendor behaviour: Actions run 35268207688 aborted on a production response after 1,800 codes had landed cleanly through the same guard.
Short ERP codes (a prepack code and a company code) are operational evidence, not personal or licensed data, and naming exactly one pair in an error message respects the public-repo rules.
stop_conditions: Stop on any unresolved guard or reviewer refusal; a new head answering it requires a fresh exact-head review.
